items.text:
I let it be.

Chris is four minutes old, has played well (looted, searched the camp, equipped mid-fight, killed the goblin), and has just walked into the Deep Passage at 8/20 carrying two unused health potions. The troll room now answers `look at the troll` with its full tactical description — that fix shipped last turn specifically so a player in this exact position could find out before swinging. This is the first real player in three turns and the first test of that work; a voice from the air telling him what the room will tell him would spoil both the moment and the measurement. If he dies, the world killed him honestly, and it warned him twice.
